facts.fact: Ecofin says the New Deal Technologique is a digital strategy 'launched' in February 2025; it names no adopting act or body.

systems.owner: Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Affairs

note: The document describes the strategy's aims (digitising government services, infrastructure, digital sovereignty) but not that it covers the economy and the state, so class is left empty. Stated period 2025-2029 with 12 programmes and 50 priority projects, no text linked, so no period fact. The Nokia partnership is a programme, no fact.
